info.title: Bootimus API
info.description: REST API of the Bootimus PXE and HTTP boot server. Responses are JSON of the form {success, message, error, data}. Endpoints marked x-bootimus-readonly are available to read-only users; all others need an admin token.

tags.name: SAN Targets
tags.description: iSCSI, AoE and HTTP SAN boot targets that clients can boot from with iPXE sanboot.

tags.name: Deployment Profiles
tags.description: Named bundles of image, auto-install file, SAN target, bootloader set and first-boot action, resolved at boot time for the clients and groups they are assigned to.

tags.name: Enrolment Rules
tags.description: Rules that place newly discovered clients into a group and deployment profile from their MAC, inventory and firmware.

tags.name: Driver Packs
tags.description: Windows driver packs injected into boot.wim.

tags.name: Kubernetes
tags.description: Clusters, node images and node enrolment.

tags.name: Multi-site
tags.description: Primary-side sync feed and replica control.

tags.name: Boot
tags.description: Endpoints served to PXE clients on the boot port; no authentication.

tags.name: Boot passwords
tags.description: Menu and image authentication, separate from admin access.
